body:
I'm running ART 1.26.3 on a Macbook. When I try to change the main font in the settings (Appearance->Main Font), the program crashes before opening any font chooser.

The OS produces a long report completed with stack trace and other gory details which I can send to Apple.

It is too long to paste here, however I think it might be useful to attach the first part in order to provide some information.

Let me know if you need more details.

title: ART crashes when trying to change interface font on Mac OS
